persona.name: Ref picker
persona.goal: Pick face, pose, and outfit references offline for AI generation without hopping three sites.
persona.pain: Split UIs, credits in the hero, inconsistent filters, no proof the full image set is intact.

issues: Three separate pages instead of one workflow
Creator / open-chat CTAs in hero and mid-page on costume and pose
Portrait has no credit footer; costume/pose duplicate credit blocks
No automated check that every cue maps to on-disk full-size files

usabilityTasks.scenario: Need a short-hair face ref for a character sheet.
usabilityTasks.goal: Open Portrait, filter Face + Short, open one card, download full size.
usabilityTasks.success: Modal download href points under /portrait/ and file exists.

usabilityTasks.scenario: Need a standing pose from the sexy full-body line.
usabilityTasks.goal: Switch to Pose, filter Full · sexy + Front, open a pose group.
usabilityTasks.success: Angle strip and modal download under /pose/ work without leaving the page.

usabilityTasks.goal: Switch to Costume, filter Spring, open one card, download.
usabilityTasks.success: Category filter reduces grid; download under /costume/.

criteria.text: One page at / browses all three libraries without leaving the app
Footer keeps license copy; header credits Gia via X (@giaaibusi), not GitHub
Cue counts match expectedCounts for portrait, costume, and pose
Every cue has on-disk thumb and original (costume also preview); zero missing files
No MixCue part field on any gallery cue
Library-specific filters render for the active library
Modal can open a cue and expose a full-size download href under the active library mount
